- [Pre-Flight Checklist](https://ucdrones.github.io/library/preflight_checklist.docx) (DOCX)
- [Mission Checklist](https://ucdrones.github.io/library/mission_checklist_template.docx) (DOCX)
- [Emergency Procedures](https://ucdrones.github.io/library/emergency_procedure_checklists.docx) (DOCX)
